summary_table: M. Y. M. Zaghloul et al. (2024)
Assessment of the tribological performance of glass fiber reinforced polyamide 6 under harsh abrasive environments
25% GF reinforcement increased the PV limit to 1.04 MPa·m/s; fibres act as a protective matrix shield.
C. de Paula Anjolleto et al. (2024)
Mechanical and tribological characterization of PA66/graphite nanocomposites
3 wt% nanographite reduced wear by >50%, acting as both a structural hardener and solid lubricant.
Wear performance of short fiber added polyamide composites produced by additive manufacturing
Thermal annealing significantly improved inter-layer adhesion and surface hardness, reducing specific wear.
Study on tribological properties of gear material PA66 reinforced by glass fibers
High humidity caused surface plasticisation, entirely shifting wear from adhesive to severe abrasive.
Effect of Molybdenum Disulfide ($MoS_2$) reinforcement on the structural, thermal, mechanical, and tribological analysis of novel polyamide 6,6
5 wt% $MoS_2$ was the optimal limit for wear reduction; higher loadings caused abrasive particle agglomeration.
Effect of surface-treated nanofillers on abrasive wear of CF/PA composites
Silane surface treatment enhanced interfacial bonding, halving the specific wear rate vs. untreated fibres.
Evaluation of mechanical, thermal, and tribological properties of 3D-printed nylon (PA6) hybrid composites
MWCNTs bridged gaps between short carbon fibres, improving composite thermal stability and wear resistance.
Effects of absorption on the tribological properties of carbon fiber reinforced polyamide-6 composites
Moisture absorption drastically reduced matrix shear strength, expediting premature carbon fibre pull-out.
Effect of hybrid graphene nanoplatelets and molybdenum disulfide fillers on PA66 composites
5 wt% hybrid GnP/$MoS_2$ formed a highly stable, thermally conductive transfer film on the counterface.
Preparation and properties of PA6 composites reinforced by $CaSO_4$ whiskers
$CaSO_4$ mineral whiskers acted as nucleating agents, increasing PA6 matrix crystallinity by 15%.
Quantitative analysis of tribological performance in PA6/nano-zeolite composites: Integration of CV and ML
Machine learning predicted polymer macroscopic wear rates with 94% accuracy based purely on filler dispersion.
Effect of relative humidity on tribological and mechanical properties of PA6-based composites
80%+ relative humidity increased the specific wear rate of porous 3D-printed parts by 40%.
Investigation of the mechanical and tribological properties of thermal aged PA6/CF composites
Prolonged thermal aging caused severe matrix embrittlement, increasing the volumetric wear rate by 38%.
Tribological behavior of silane-treated nanofiller reinforced CF/PA6 composites
Silane-treated composites exhibited 45% better fibre retention within the matrix during repeated abrasion.
Tribological performance of cast and extruded PA6 for wafer machinery applications
Cast PA6G (anionic polymerization) achieved a lower friction coefficient (0.16) than standard extruded PA6.
Dry sliding wear of PA66 filled with rice bran ceramics under wide PV range
Dry sliding across extreme PV limits
Eco-friendly Rice Bran Ceramics (RBC) prevented catastrophic thermal melting transitions at high PV loads.
Quantitative mapping of linear tooth profile wear for PA6 and PA66 gears
Successfully established mathematical mapping between initial contact pressures and geometric gear tooth wear.
Coupled numerical-experimental wear prediction of PA66 sprockets using UMESHMOTION
Drive chain elongation dynamically increased contact pressure by 1.5x, leading to a predicted 90 µm wear depth.
High-temperature sliding friction and wear of glass fiber reinforced PA66
Friction surged 8.7x at 110°C due to modulus drop, but 33% GF reinforcement stabilized the mechanical load.
Fretting wear mechanisms of GF-PA66 in high-speed railway infrastructure
High-frequency micromotion induced rapid subsurface fatigue and distinct micro-cratering independent of sliding.
Effect of PA66 dip-coating process on wind turbine pitch bearing cages
PA66 vulcanized dip-coating shifted contact from steel-to-steel to plastic-to-steel, extending bearing fatigue life.
Failure analysis of SCF-PA66 gears under combined torque and bending fatigue
Short Carbon Fiber (SCF) reinforcement successfully extended PA66 gear fatigue life to $2 \times 10^9$ cycles.
